question: Which bimetallic loading does the Pd/Cu photocatalytic ozonation study find indispensable for suppressing bacterial regrowth after treatment, and what average particle diameter did the TiO2 catalyst at that loading have?
rendered:
The study finds that a higher loading of 1.0 wt % Pd/Cu is strictly indispensable for suppressing long-term bacterial regrowth and preventing the biological resuscitation of resistance markers during post-treatment storage.

At a Pd/Cu loading of 1.0 wt %, the average diameter of the measured particles of the (Pd/Cu)1%TiO2 catalyst is 11.1 ± 6.8 nm.
